7.text: An exquisite piece uncovered during a fierce battle with the Flashfire Hanifolk. One of many swords found stuck in what seemed to be a storeroom, it gives off an intense chill.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Windwrath Steambot wings. Driven by a combustion engine and clever aerodynamics, this mechanical axe unleashes searing slashes wreathed in blazing wind.
An exquisite piece uncovered during a fierce battle with the Flashfire Hanifolk. A great bow made to fire not arrows, but sticks packed with gunpowder.
An exquisite piece uncovered during a fierce battle with the Flashfire Hanifolk. These mysterious gloves, a gift from a Hani in an apron, keep out every last bit of heat.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Maelstrom Steambot engine parts. Clockwork gears surround its magic core, and the necklace transforms to boost its output.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Radiant Steambot steam pipes. Steam pressure accelerates its bullets even further, riddling any target with holes.
